playoff_format.second_berth: highest second-half winning percentage excluding the first-half champion

strength_model.standardization: Each selected Power view is z-standardized across the 10-team league before weighting.

home_field.method: Current-season Texas League home win percentage shrunk toward .500 with a neutral prior.

playoff_forecast.note: These are model estimates, not official probabilities. The matchup conversion is intentionally conservative and should be recalibrated after out-of-sample backtesting.

view_definitions.overall: All completed regular-season games for each team.
view_definitions.first_half: Official first-half standings and each team's first official first-half game count for schedule-based OWP.
view_definitions.second_half: Official second-half standings and each team's most recent official second-half game count for schedule-based OWP.
view_definitions.recent: Each team's most recent up to 30 completed regular-season games. The newest 18 games count at full weight. Games 19-30 fade linearly from 12/13 weight down to 1/13, and game 31 and older contribute zero to Recent Power.

trend_basis: Within each view, rank arrows compare against that same view's weekly baseline snapshot from Monday or the first available snapshot of the current week.
power_delta_basis: Within each view, Power delta compares against the same weekly baseline snapshot used for that view's rank arrows.

power_formula.formula: raw_power_score = 50% Run Differential Per Game + 25% Actual Winning Percentage + 25% Average Opponent Winning Percentage
power_formula.diff: Run Differential Per Game = normalized run differential per game within the selected view. Recent uses the 18-full + 12-game linear-fade weights.
power_formula.actual_winning_percentage: Actual Winning Percentage = normalized winning percentage within the selected view. Recent uses the same linear-fade game weights for the Power input.
power_formula.opponent_strength: Average Opponent Winning Percentage = opponents' winning percentages within the same selected view after excluding games against the team being evaluated, bounded-normalized against .450 to .550

power_smoothing.formula: Overall, First Half, and Second Half smooth changed inputs as previous_smoothed_power_score * 0.75 + raw_power_score * 0.25. Recent uses no additional smoothing because its 18-game full-weight core plus 12-game linear fade already provides temporal smoothing.
power_smoothing.state_note: The internal smoothed_power_state is stored without display rounding for smoothed views. Recent stores its current raw score in the same field for schema compatibility. When the model version changes, smoothed views reset to the new raw score instead of blending incompatible model states.

power_compression.note: Compression is applied once after smoothing and is not fed back into the next smoothing step.

owp.formula: For each selected team game, use that opponent's winning percentage from the same view after excluding all games against the team being evaluated, then average those opponent values. Opponents remain weighted by games played. In Recent, opponent records and each faced-opponent contribution use the same 18-full + 12-game linear-fade weights. If an opponent has no independent games after the exclusion, use neutral .500. OWP score is bounded-normalized so .450 = 0, .500 = 50, and .550 = 100.

recent_window.weight_formula: rank newest-to-oldest as r=1,2,...; weight=1 for r<=18; weight=(31-r)/13 for 19<=r<=30; weight=0 for r>=31
recent_window.display_fields: Recent rows expose weighted_win_pct, weighted_rs, weighted_ra, weighted_run_differential, and weighted OWP so the table can display the same recency-weighted inputs used by Recent Power.

first_half.label: First Half
first_half.description: Games assigned to the official first half.

second_half.label: Second Half
second_half.description: Games assigned to the official second half.

recent.label: Recent
recent.description: Each team's most recent up to 30 completed games: the newest 18 count at full weight and games 19-30 fade linearly.
